title: Speed at point B
description: Essential: Correctly applies centripetal force equation at B using given normal force to find v_B = 4 m/s.

title: Speed at point D
description: Important: Correctly calculates acceleration on conveyor belt and uses kinematics to find v_D = 5 m/s.

title: Projectile landing speed
description: Essential: Correctly computes time of flight and combines velocity components to find landing speed magnitude as (5√13)/2 m/s.

title: Post-collision speed along plane
description: Essential: Correctly resolves pre-collision velocity into components along the incline to find initial sliding speed = 8.5 m/s.

title: Average normal force
description: Important: Correctly applies impulse-momentum or kinematics perpendicular to incline to find average normal force = 7 N.

title: Energy or friction sign error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies work-energy on conveyor belt (e.g., ignoring relative motion) or uses wrong sign for friction acceleration.

title: Projectile geometry mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly relates horizontal displacement to vertical drop using the incline angle (tan θ = y/x).

title: Vector resolution error
description: Pitfall: Makes error in resolving velocity components parallel/perpendicular to the incline before or after collision.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout and includes units in final answers.
